question: Where are a gallery located within 110 kilometers distance toward the northeast of Bresnan Arena, Mankato, MN?
sql: WITH bresnan_arena AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Bresnan Arena%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Mankato%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MN%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT P.poi_name FROM pois AS P, bresnan_arena AS BA WHERE P.tourism ILIKE '%gallery%' AND ST_DWithin( P.geometry::geography, BA.geometry::geography, 110000 ) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( BA.geometry, P.geometry )) BETWEEN 22.5 AND 67.5;
